executiveSummary: Overall OT Threat Level: HIGH Active campaigns are targeting Siemens S7-200/300/400/1200/1500 PLCs using AI-assisted scripts (snap7) over TCP/102. Immediate actions: remove internet exposure, harden protection levels, and monitor for unauthorized PUT/GET. Security Advisory Iranian-affiliated actors are modifying PLC logic and HMI/SCADA displays at U.S. water and energy sites (CompactLogix, Micro850, Modicon M340, S7-1200). Expect logic tampering, alarm suppression, and loss of view if boundaries are weak. Security Advisory Pro-Russia hacktivists are opportunistically accessing exposed VNC services on OT HMIs (ports 5900-5910) causing setpoint changes and downtime. Disable public VNC immediately and broker remote access through MFA-protected jump hosts. Security Advisory Widely deployed perimeter devices remain prime targets: a pre-auth RCE with public PoC affects NetScaler ADC/Gateway, and multiple CISA KEV additions confirm active exploitation of SonicWall SMA1000, JFrog Artifactory and others-prioritize patching and compromise assessment. Security Advisory KEV Update Multiple OT-native vulnerabilities demand near-term maintenance windows: Danfoss iC7 drives (unsigned apps/firmware risk), OPC UA Eclipse Milo server flaws (auth bypass and DoS), and NetStaX EtherNet/IP stack Class 3 overflow-apply patches and enforce ICS-aware DPI at cell/zone boundaries. CISA Bulletin CISA Bulletin ICS Advisory Strategic activity continues: China-nexus covert networks of compromised SOHO/IoT are used for CNI pre-positioning; PRC APTs persist on backbone/edge devices to siphon credentials and traffic. Harden router/SNMP/AAA, disable legacy services, and coordinate full eviction plans. Joint Advisory Joint Advisory Cisco Nexus 9000 (Silicon One) exposes a 9.8 unauthenticated root RCE; urgently block TCP 43210/43211 and upgrade to fixed NX-OS. View Article Zimbra zero-day (now patched) used by Russian APT exfiltrated enterprise mail and credentials; if impacted, revoke app passwords/2FA scratch codes, reset credentials, and purge malicious messages. Security Advisory Priority: remove public exposure of PLCs and VNC; patch/evict on NetScaler/SonicWall/Artifactory; deploy ICS-aware monitoring for ENIP/S7comm; lock identity and router/SNMP hygiene per joint advisories.

relevance: Most impacted OT domains Water and Wastewater Systems: PLC logic manipulation, exposed VNC on HMIs, remote access abuse Energy and Power: Controller communication stack flaws (ENIP/OPC UA), router/edge device compromises Critical Manufacturing: Drive and relay/hardware update tool exposures, NetStaX-based device overflow Transportation/Aviation: Data theft and supply-chain exposure (airports), EVSE charger RCE risks Key MITRE ATT&CK (Enterprise/ICS) observations T1190 Exploit Public-Facing Application; T1133 External Remote Services T1552/T1555 Credential Access; ICS: T0814 Exploit Public-Facing Application, T0829 Loss of View ICS protocol abuse: ENIP/CIP Class 3 overflow attempt; S7comm writes (TCP/102); OPC UA auth bypass Lateral movement: Valid accounts, VPN reuse, router AAA/SNMP tampering, SPAN/PCAP for traffic mirroring

items: Danfoss iC7 drives (GR3): unsigned applications/firmware upload & parameter manipulation-enforce signing, segment service interfaces. CISA SB26-243
Eclipse Milo (OPC UA): auth bypass, diagnostics exposure, resource exhaustion-patch; disable old policies; enforce SignAndEncrypt. CISA SB26-222
Pyramid NetStaX EtherNet/IP stack: Class 3 explicit message overflow-upgrade to v5.6.1; detect oversized payloads with ICS DPI. ICSA-26-246-07
EVSE/DC chargers & brokers (EVbee, ActiveMQ paths): unauth RCE/command injection; lock down OCPP, mutual TLS, signed updates. CISA SB26-215
Industry 4.0 AAS (Eclipse BaSyx Go Components): ABAC bypass enabling unauthorized read/write/upload-upgrade immediately. CISA SB26-208
